articles.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
articles.content: It's still unknown how attackers got access to Anthropic's verified Cursor account.
articles.titleZh: Cursor后门上的Anthropic VS代码扩展近12小时
articles.contentZh: 目前尚不清楚攻击者是如何访问Anthropic已验证的Cursor帐户的。

articles.title: Code-execution flaw in UEFI firmware affects most servers on planet Earth
articles.content: Critical flaw in EDK2 allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process.
articles.titleZh: UEFI固件中的代码执行缺陷影响地球上的大多数服务器
articles.contentZh: EDK2中的关键缺陷允许攻击者在引导过程的早期执行代码。

articles.title: Disgraced eMudhra drops out of TLS business after using cert private key of 4
articles.content: Flubbed key signing "ceremony" allowed minting of web credentials for any site.
articles.titleZh: 丢脸的eMudhra在使用4的证书私钥后退出TLS业务
articles.contentZh: 错误的密钥签名“仪式”允许为任何站点铸造Web凭据。

articles.title: 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email
articles.content: For 3 days this month, 333 exit nodes were hacked in hopes of stealing sensitive data.
articles.titleZh: 333个Tor出口节点被劫持以拦截SSH流量并检索明文电子邮件
articles.contentZh: 本月3天， 333个出口节点被黑客入侵，希望窃取敏感数据。

articles.content: Apple CEO John Ternus doesn't have a timeline for when iPhone Duo supply constraints could lift. articles.title: Apple set an iPhone sales record even without a new standard iPhone
articles.content: Apple had a record-breaking quarter for iPhone sales - despite not releasing a standard model during its latest refresh. In its fourth-quarter earnings report released on Monday, Apple says it earned $57.58 billion in iPhone revenue, a 17 percent jump from the same time last year.
